newsitem.title: CANADA: DBRS confirms Bank Montreal, Scotia.
newsitem.headline: DBRS confirms Bank Montreal, Scotia.

text.p: Dominion Bond Rating Service said on Thursday it confirmed its rating for Bank of Montreal and Bank of Nova Scotia, all with a stable trend.

The Toronto-based rating agency said it confirmed the deposits and senior debt for Bank of Montreal and Bank of Nova Scotia at AA, subordinated debt for both at AA (low) and cumulative preferred shares at Pfd-1.

The ratings agency said it confirmed Bank of Montreal's non-cumulative preferred shares class A, series 4, 5; class B, series 1 and 2 at Pfd-1 (low) and Bank of Nova Scotia's non-cumulative preferred shares, series 5,6,7,8,9 and 10 also at Pfd-1 (low). DBRS also rated Bank of Montreal and Bank of Nova Scotia's short-term instruments at R-1 (middle). All ratings were confirmed with a stable trend.

Dominion said it confirmed its ratings for the two banks because of record profits at both, lower loan losses and favorable investment banking activities at Bank of Nova Scotia as well as non-interest income and consumer loan growth at Bank of Montreal.
